name: hud_ui_controls_dialog_constructor_cluster
description: HudUiControlsDialog constructs its background, resume and commands buttons, five option selectors, handles the missing dialog.zrd path, seeds selector indices from zInp/zOpt state, and runs the dialog cleanup paths.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers the HudUiControlsDialog constructor/lifecycle cluster.

The native smoke intentionally avoids local Controls FTable/Vtbl identity assertions because production source no longer recreates those owner-local table globals; the constructor remains blocked on the broader HudUiBackground/HudUiElement class dispatch owner.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408a30 validates the construction order: HudUiBackground, resume and commands HudUiZrdWidget children, mouse/joystick, throttle, steering, cursor, and camera HudUiOptionSelectorWidget children, then compiler-generated dispatch table writes for the dialog and child objects. These table writes are class-owner evidence, not source permission for hand-authored production FTable/Vtbl globals.

Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408a30 validates loading dialog.zrd/CONTROLS_DIALOG, binding RESUME, COMMANDS_BTN, MOUSE_OR_JOYSTICK, THROTTLE_MODE, STEERING_MODE, CURSOR_MODE, and CAMERA_MODE when present, freeing loaded roots, and seeding selectors from zInp::GetJoystickOption, zOpt::GetThrottleMode, zOpt::GetSteeringMode, zOpt::GetCursorMode, and zOpt::GetCameraModePlayerState.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408c20 validates the commands button activation override: queue HudCmdDialogState, then chain HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408c70 and 0x408c40 validates reverse child destruction order, base background destruction, and scalar deleting behavior that deletes only when flags bit 0 is set.
The native smoke hud_ui_controls_dialog_constructor_smoke verifies the recovered class-owner model without requiring removed owner-local FTable/Vtbl globals.
